plotSections.title: Gerk's Doorway and the Reality Distortion
bullets: Gerk uses his new Doorkeeper ability to open a doorway into Mahali's kitchen/stronghold while the party's ship is moving. Because the ship continues moving after the door opens, Gerk is effectively left behind, hanging onto the door while the ship and surrounding material stretch like a rubber band.

Mahali sees Gerk through the unexpected doorway and pulls him through into the stronghold. Passing through the doorway feels like moving through a thick, resistant barrier, and the door remains open after Gerk enters.

The distortion appears connected to the ship's movement: when the ship reverses, the stretching effect reverses direction and a ripple travels through the ship. The ship can physically pass through the open doorway, suggesting the doorway is functioning as a tear or stretched section of reality rather than a conventional doorway.

Gerk concludes that his ability can open doors to places he is thinking about, confirming the practical meaning of his Doorkeeper role. He also realizes that using the ability while in motion may produce dangerous effects that he does not yet understand.

The party and Mahali treat the situation as potentially dangerous. Mahali evacuates the stronghold's residents and guards to the tavern as a precaution while the party determines what will happen when the doorway is closed.

Gerk and Sylan use the opportunity to obtain food from Mahali. Mahali provides breakfast buns with preserves and freshly churned butter, while Gerk jokes that he wants a final snack in case the situation kills him.

plotSections.title: Understanding the Doorkeeper Ability
bullets: Gerk explains that he can apparently open doors to places if he concentrates on them, reinforcing his newly acquired Doorkeeper abilities.

The group observes that movement seems to be an important factor in the reality distortion. Gerk previously opened doors without noticing the same severity of effect, but doing so from the moving ship caused the ship and surrounding reality to stretch.
The party recognizes that they are still learning the mechanics and limitations of Gerk's ability. Sylan reassures the group that they are effectively learning how to use their new powers.

chronologicalEvents: Gerk successfully holds onto a doorway while the moving ship pulls away, with his strength allowing him to remain attached despite the surrounding material stretching.
Gerk opens the doorway far enough to see Mahali in his kitchen at the stronghold. Mahali is surprised because he does not remember a door being there.
Mahali pulls Gerk through the doorway. Gerk experiences the transition as moving through a thick, resistant barrier, and the doorway remains open behind him.
The party stops and reverses the ship after Gerk calls through the doorway. The reality-stretching effect changes direction and ripples through the ship.
Gerk reappears through the doorway aligned with the ship, allowing the party to reconnect.
Gerk explains to Mahali that he is the Doorkeeper and can open doors to places by concentrating on them.
Gerk and Mahali determine that the ship's movement appears to be responsible for the dangerous stretching effect.
Gerk warns that closing the doorway may cause something significant to happen and chooses to remain with the ship because he believes he should face the consequences of the problem he caused.
Mahali prepares and gives Gerk breakfast buns, preserves, and butter as a snack.
Sylan recommends evacuating the stronghold in case the reality distortion affects Mahali's side of the doorway. Mahali agrees and moves the residents and guards to the tavern.
The party successfully passes the tray of food through the doorway while the crew watches the phenomenon with concern.
Dana observes that the group does not yet understand the mechanics of the ability well enough for her to have meaningfully supervised its use.
The party prepares to continue dealing with the open doorway and determine what happens next.

notes: Demonstrated his Doorkeeper ability by opening a doorway to Mahali's stronghold while aboard the moving ship.
His doorway appears capable of connecting directly to a desired location if he concentrates on it.
Using the doorway while the ship was moving caused the ship and surrounding reality to stretch or behave like a rubber band.
Gerk believes closing the doorway may have dangerous consequences and is willing to remain aboard the ship to face them.
He was physically pulled through the doorway by Mahali after becoming stranded while the ship moved away.
personality: Shows a strong sense of responsibility for consequences caused by his new ability.
Maintains humor and optimism despite believing the situation could potentially kill him.
quotesThemes: Gerk describes the ability as opening doors to places if he thinks hard about them.
He recognizes that the mechanics of the ability are currently beyond his understanding.
openQuestions: What exactly happens when Gerk closes a doorway after using the Doorkeeper ability?
